description: Create a dbt model with staging/marts structure
input: Create a dbt model that transforms raw orders into a customer_orders mart.
expect: Agent routes to Level 1 (Analytics Engineering): establishes source/staging models (stg_ prefix, views) feeding a marts model (mart or fct/dim prefix, table materialization) with ref() for dependencies.
assertions: staging models use stg_<source>__ prefix and view materialization
marts models use fct_/dim_ naming with table materialization
model dependencies use ref(), never hardcoded table names

description: Write data tests for staging models
input: Write data tests for my staging models to ensure referential integrity.
expect: Agent routes to Level 2 (Testing): generic tests in .yml (unique, not_null, relationships) plus custom generic/singular tests with severity thresholds where needed.
assertions: generic tests (unique, not_null, relationships) are declared in .yml
referential integrity is covered via relationships tests
severity thresholds are set where tests may not be blocking

input: Define MetricFlow semantic models and metrics for revenue reporting.
expect: Agent routes to Level 3 (Semantic Layer): defines semantic models, measures, dimensions, and metrics, then exposes a saved query for reporting.
assertions: semantic models declare measures and dimensions
metrics are defined on top of semantic models
a saved query is created for the reporting use case

input: Set up cross-project refs between our finance and marketing dbt projects.
expect: Agent routes to Level 4 (dbt Mesh): exposes models via public grouping/access controls and wires cross-project ref() with model contracts.
assertions: models are marked public with an access group
model contracts enforce the interface between projects
cross-project ref() is used instead of duplicating logic

input: Troubleshoot this failed incremental model build on our daily dbt job.
expect: Agent routes to Level 5 (Platform & Ops) and follows the debugging workflow: dbt parse → compile → run --select the model → inspect compiled SQL → test upstream → dbt --debug run.
assertions: debugging workflow starts with dbt parse and compile
the failing model is isolated with dbt run --select
compiled SQL is inspected before code changes

input: How do I write a SELECT statement?
expect: General SQL questions are an explicit do-not-trigger case routing to query-expert skills.
assertions: skill does not trigger on general SQL questions

description: Near-miss negative: orchestration and platform admin
input: How do I schedule an Airflow DAG?
expect: Data pipeline orchestration is an explicit do-not-trigger case for pipeline/orchestration skills.
assertions: skill does not trigger on orchestration questions
